items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew him very well. He did a wonderful “Piano Jazz” show... he worked with Jimmy all the time.

ctx.x: And did you ever have someone like Ralph Sharon or Red Richards or someone?

I had Ralph Sharon. Red Richards. I feel so bad about him, because he worked with Jimmy all the time. I knew him very well. He did a wonderful “Piano Jazz” show, because it’s so historical. Do you have that one?
I think I do have that one.
